## [SeekDeep](seekdeep.qmd)

The main pipeline programs: extraction, per-sample clustering and population clustering.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [extractor](seekdeep.qmd#extractor) | Extract sequences from various sequences input types (fastq,fasta,etc.) with primers and barcodes plus some filtering |
| [extractorByKmerMatching](seekdeep.qmd#extractorByKmerMatching) | Extract each target's reads from one sample's long reads (e.g. |
| [extractorPairedEnd](seekdeep.qmd#extractorPairedEnd) | Extract sequences from various sequences input types (fastq,fasta,sff,etc.) with primers and barcodes plus some filtering |
| [kluster](seekdeep.qmd#kluster) | Cluster one sample's reads of one target by k-mer similarity, the alternative to qluster for high error rate reads like nanopore and pacbio. |
| [makeSampleDirectories](seekdeep.qmd#makeSampleDirectories) | Make the directory tree processClusters reads from a table of sample names, one directory per sample with a subdirectory per replicate, plus locationByIndex/... |
| [processClusters](seekdeep.qmd#processClusters) | Ran from inside directory tree set up such that currentDir/SampleDir/RunDir/seqFiles |
| [qluster](seekdeep.qmd#qluster) | Cluster input sequences by collapsing on set differences between the sequences |

## [Pmo](pmo.qmd)

Building, merging and validating [Portable Microhaplotype Object (PMO)](https://plasmogenepi.github.io/PMO_Docs/) files.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [addSpecimenMetaToPmo](pmo.qmd#addSpecimenMetaToPmo) | Add the columns of a table as specimen fields in a PMO, columns that aren't in the PMO schema are added as custom fields |
| [addTargetGenomeInfoToPmo](pmo.qmd#addTargetGenomeInfoToPmo) | Add each target's genome, insert and primer locations, and the genes its insert overlaps (gene_name as GENE_ID:GENE_NAME) to a PMO, from where SeekDeep... |
| [mergeMinimumPmos](pmo.qmd#mergeMinimumPmos) | Merge minimum PMOs, for example PMOs per target over the same samples, into one PMO, genomes and haplotype variants are carried over, PMOs with project,... |
| [validatePmo](pmo.qmd#validatePmo) | Check a PMO against the format and print what's in it |
